summary: Support new metadata types through a focused internal scanner registry first
rationale: The current scanner is modular and already has type-specific scanner modules; an internal generic registry keeps the release slice reviewable while preserving a future path to @salesforce/source-deploy-retrieve registry adoption.
outcome: Implement directory and file detection for the issue-listed metadata types with tests, add AiAuthoringBundle/CustomSite/DigitalExperienceBundle types and ordering where missing, and defer full SDR registry replacement to a later architecture task.
alternatives: hardcoded ad hoc checks inside metadata-scanner-service

summary: Propagate project API version into manifest generation instead of hardcoding package.xml version
rationale: The issue combines metadata type misclassification with manifest version drift; fixing only the scanner would still emit the wrong package version for sourceApiVersion 66.0 projects.
outcome: Add a stable apiVersion field to scan/deployment context or manifest params, default safely when unavailable, and cover with manifest tests.

summary: Normalize forceignore checks against both package-relative and project-relative paths
rationale: Issue patterns include force-app/main/default/... and **/aiAuthoringBundles/**; directory scans must evaluate paths in the same shape users put in .forceignore.
outcome: Enhance ForceIgnoreParser matching without replacing it wholesale, and add regression tests for the exact aiAuthoringBundles patterns.

summary: Namespace identity: concrete ns OR vlocity.yaml-declared ns for token
rationale: Human-approved amendment to architect doc TBD#1: any concrete <ns>__ prefix counts as identity (not a fixed allowlist), per project decision. The unresolved %vlocity_namespace% token is only resolvable via a project-declared namespace read from a minimal VBT job file (vlocity.yaml 'namespace:' property) at the project root, injectable via the classifier's readFile param for tests. No new config surface, CMDT, or org call was added. Reused extractNamespace() from src/parsers/apex-class-names.ts for concrete-prefix detection instead of the broader isManagedPackage() in dependency-resolution-classifier.ts, which flags any Foo__c and would over-match unnamespaced custom fields.

rationale: All 4 ACs traced to tests with no gaps (case 1-14 doc matrix fully covered); 47 focused tests + 1820/0/8 full suite pass against committed HEAD fe1b418; independent black-box run of real 'plan explain' command on disposable fixture confirms no vlocity command, no job placeholder token, Remedy on every blocked error, native/managed never dual-admitted, and no DataPack record reaches the core manifest.
